newsitem.title: USA: Marisa sees '97 earnings level with '96.
newsitem.headline: Marisa sees '97 earnings level with '96.

text.p: Marisa Christina Inc said Tuesday that it expects its 1997 earnings to remain level with those of 1996 because of increased investment in marketing and advertising.
The company said it is investing about $2.5 to $3 million in additional marketing and advertising programs for 1997, which it said will more than double 1996 corporate marketing expenditures.

"The investment will be used for in-store shops, special events, public relations, as well as advertising. The majority of this budget will be devoted to our Vittadini brand, presently our fastest growing division," the company said.
Earlier today, Marisa Christina reported third quarter earnings of $0.25 per share, down from $0.48 in the year-ago quarter.
